source.name: Original generated factories for the exact installed Factorio prototypes

policies.raw: Natural resources delivered to boundary; no extraction machinery included.
policies.intermediary: Direct ingredients of a preferred installed target recipe are supplied.
policies.mixed: Complex direct ingredients supplied; simple ingredients expanded to natural resources.
policies.evidence: Calculated balance and generated blueprint are not native production evidence. All-complete requires each recipe product variant to pass matched native tests.
policies.rate: Demand rate with rounded machine capacity. Extra capacity is not a measured output rate.
